title: KafkaClusterV2
description: Definition of a managed Kafka cluster that can be provisioned in Instaclustr.

clientBrokerAuthWithMtls.description: Enables Client ⇄ Broker Authentication with mTLS.

defaultNumberOfPartitions.description: Default number of partitions to use when created new topics.

karapaceRestProxy.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Karapace REST Proxy to this Kafka cluster.

autoCreateTopics.description: Allows topics to be auto created by brokers when messages are published to a non-existent topic

privateNetworkCluster.description: Creates the cluster with private network only, see [Private Network Clusters](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/private-network-clusters/).

kafkaVersion.description:
Version of Kafka to run on the cluster. Available versions:
  • `3.9.2`
  • `4.3.1`
  • `4.1.2`
  • `4.2.1`

resizeSettings.description: Settings to determine how resize requests will be performed for the cluster.

pciComplianceMode.description: Creates a PCI compliant cluster, see [PCI Compliance](https://www.instaclustr.com/support/documentation/useful-information/pci-compliance/).

schemaRegistry.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Schema Registry to this Kafka cluster.

dedicatedKraftController.description: Provision additional dedicated nodes for KRaft Controllers. If this is not provided, some Kafka brokers will be required to act as KRaft controllers.

defaultReplicationFactor.description: Default Replication factor to use for new topic. Also represents the number of racks to use when allocating nodes.

allowDeleteTopics.description: Allows topics to be deleted via the kafka-topics tool

defaultUserPassword.description: Password for the default Kafka user

karapaceSchemaRegistry.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka Karapace Schema Registry to this Kafka cluster.

kraft.description:
Create a collocated KRaft Cluster.

Note that this is the default behaviour for Kafka clusters provisioned using Kafka 3.6.1 and later.
Kafka clusters provisioned with earlier Kafka versions will use a collocated Zookeeper cluster instead.

restProxy.description: Adds the specified version of Kafka REST Proxy to this Kafka cluster.

collocatedZookeeper.description:
Create a Collocated Zookeeper Cluster - use this to create
a collocated zookeeper based Kafka cluster for kafka versions >= 3.6.1.

Note that collocated KRaft mode is the default mode for Kafka clusters using versions older than 3.6.1.
Kafka 3.6.1 and later will use KRaft instead of Zookeeper unless this is specified.

dedicatedZookeeper.description: Provision additional dedicated nodes for Apache Zookeeper to run on. Zookeeper nodes will be co-located with Kafka if this is not provided

cidr.description: Network CIDR in notation, for example 10.0.0.0/16.

primary.description: True when this entry is the data centre primary network.

status.description: Provisioning status of the network registration.

CdcNetworkDetailsV2.description: A network CIDR associated with the data centre (primary or expanded secondary).

CloudProviderEnumV2.description: Name of a cloud provider service.

CurrentClusterOperationStatusV2.description: Indicates if the cluster is currently performing any restructuring operation such as being created or resized

CurrentOperationsV2.description: Active operations in the data centre.

created.description: Timestamp of the creation of the operation

modified.description: Timestamp of the last modification of the operation

nodeId.description: ID of the node being replaced.

numberOfNodesToDelete.description: Number of nodes set to delete in the operation.

created.description: Timestamp of the creation of the operation

modified.description: Timestamp of the last modification of the operation

cdcId.description: ID of the Cluster Data Centre.

endpointUrl.description: URL to which the client telemetry will be sent.

authenticationHeaders.description: Optional HTTP headers for the client telemetry endpoint (for example API key or custom authentication headers). When any entry is provided, each must include a non-empty key and value. Duplicate header names are not permitted.

basicAuthentication.description: Basic authentication settings for Client Telemetry endpoint.

enabled.description: Toggle to enable or disable Client Telemetry for Kafka.

KafkaClientTelemetry.description: Cluster configuration settings for Kafka Client Telemetry.

KafkaClientTelemetryAuthenticationHeader.description: Optional HTTP header sent with OTLP requests to the client telemetry endpoint (for example API keys). When included in the request, key and value must each be a non-empty string (after trimming).

password.description: Password for basic authentication when shipping client telemetry.

username.description: Username for basic authentication when shipping client telemetry.

KafkaClientTelemetryBasicAuthentication.description: Optional configuration to enable basic authentication when shipping client telemetry.

deletedNodes.description: List of deleted nodes in the data centre

awsSettings.description: AWS specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with GCP or Azure settings.
awsSettings.x-insta-comment: due to a bug with the terraform provider openapi plugin this has to be a list instead of a nested object. Also has to be computed because terraform defaults lists to empty arrays when skipped, whereas the API returns null

tagManagementEnabled.description: (Optional) Enable tag management for the data centre, allowing you to create, update and delete custom tags on the data centre via Instaclustr Terraform Provider v2, Cluster Management API or Management Console. Tag management is only available for RIYOA clusters and cannot be disabled once enabled. If not specified, the current value will remain unchanged.

currentOperations.description: Active operations in the data centre.

numberOfNodes.description: Total number of Kafka brokers in the Data Centre. Must be a multiple of `defaultReplicationFactor`.

additionalListeners.description: The additional listeners to create for a kafka cluster along with the default one.

networks.description: All network CIDR blocks for this data centre, including the primary network and any expanded secondary CIDRs.

customSubjectAlternativeNames.description: List of Subject Alternative Names FQDNs as per RFC 1035.  Used by the applications with self signed certificates in keystores of nodes in the datacenter. NOTE: No private link cluster support.

network.description: The private network address block for the Data Centre specified using CIDR address notation. The network must have a prefix length between `/16` and `/26` and must be part of a private address space.

tags.description: List of tags to apply to the Data Centre. Tags are metadata labels which allow you to identify, categorize and filter clusters. This can be useful for grouping together clusters into applications, environments, or any category that you require. Note: Tags will be returned sorted by key in alphabetical order regardless of input order. Terraform users: `tag` is not supported in terraform lifecycle `ignore_changes`.

zeroInboundAccess.description: Zero Inbound Access gateways eliminate the requirement for any public IP addresses in cluster deployment.

gcpSettings.description: GCP specific settings for the Data Centre. Cannot be provided with AWS or Azure settings.
